daily_returns = rng.normal(0.0003, 0.012, 252)

t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_1samp(
    daily_returns, popmean=0.0)

reject = p_value < 0.05
caption: t = (x_bar - mu0) / (s / sqrt(n)), reference: Student's t.

eyebrow: A small true effect, one noisy year
code:
# true mean IS positive (0.0003/day)
# but one year (n=252) is often not enough
# data to push p_value below 0.05
caption: Low power to detect a small daily alpha over a short sample.

subtitle: Where hypothesis testing meets the linear model.
